paragraphs: Rav Nachman, son of Rav Gurya.

[Shabbat 95a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.95a.3) relates that he came to Nehardea. They asked him questions, and he could not answer properly; they told him, “Your teacher was a reed-cutter in the marsh.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chama bar Gurya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat paragraph explicitly makes the questioners tell Gurya’s son, “Your teacher was a reed-cutter.” The direction of the speech is corrected accordingly.

The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2680&lang=en) give Rav Nachman bar Gurya. In the linked exchange, the Nehardeans say “your teacher” to him. Hyman reports the alternative Rav Chama bar Gurya from Dikdukei Soferim.
